blocks.text: Facts here come from the municipality, TransLink or BC Transit, the Ministry of Education and Child Care, and the retailers’ own pages, listed under Sources. Walking and driving times were measured on OpenStreetMap routing on November 2, 2026, from the point named under the table.

items.t: No SkyTrain, West Coast Express or SeaBus station is in Chilliwack. Route 66 Fraser Valley Express (BC Transit) runs Downtown Chilliwack to Lougheed Station (SkyTrain), the nearest rapid-transit station.
Nearest bus exchange: Downtown Exchange, Chilliwack.

No route in BC Transit's Chilliwack list runs onto the mountain's residential streets; closest listed service: Route 59 Industrial (Downtown to Cottonwood Mall via Lickman Park & Ride), below the mountain.
Hillkeep Regional Park, at the top of the mountain: about 2 km of trails and a viewing platform (Fraser Valley Regional District).
Chilliwack Landing Leisure Centre, 9145 Corbould Street — nearest leisure centre, downtown off the mountain.
No public school is on the mountain in the Ministry Chilliwack list; the nearest listed schools are on the valley floor.
La Verendrye, grades K-7, School District 33 Chilliwack, 6610 Lickman Road, below the west side; catchment not confirmed.
Bernard Elementary, grades K-5, School District 33 Chilliwack; catchment not confirmed.
Chilliwack Secondary, grades 9-12, School District 33 Chilliwack; catchment not confirmed.
London Drugs (pharmacy), Cottonwood Centre, 21-45585 Luckakuck Way.

faq.q: Is there a bus route on Chilliwack Mountain?
faq.a: No route in BC Transit's Chilliwack list runs onto the mountain's residential streets; the closest service is route 59 Industrial via the Lickman Park & Ride.

faq.q: Is there a school on Chilliwack Mountain?
faq.a: No SD33 public school is located on the mountain in the provincial school directory for Chilliwack; confirm the catchment for any address in SD33's School Locator.

faq.q: What hillside rules apply on the mountain?
faq.a: Chilliwack Mountain is in Development Permit Area D-2 Hillside Environment, and a permit with a geotechnical hazard and slope assessment is required before subdivision, construction, land clearing or earthworks.
No neighbourhood plan for the mountain appears in Schedule B of the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan; the mountain is covered by the OCP's hillside Development Permit Areas D-2 and D-5.
